newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile posts 0.2 pct inflation in May.
newsitem.headline: Chile posts 0.2 pct inflation in May.

text.p: Consumer prices in Chile rose 0.2 percent in June, down from 0.4 percent in June 1996 and indicating for the second month in a row that inflation is running below official forecasts, the National Statistics Institute said.
The rate was unchanged from 0.2 percent in May and brought inflation in the first half of the year to 2.5 percent, the institute said.
Inflation over the 12 months to end-June was 5.3 percent -- already below the government's lowest inflation target for all of calendar 1997, 5.5 percent.
